question: Locate Aruba relative to Venezuela and identify its constitutional relationship.
raw: O1: [S1] Aruba is located 29 kilometres (18 mi) north of the Venezuelan peninsula of Paraguaná. [S1] In 1986, Aruba became a constituent country within the Kingdom of the Netherlands.
